identity.name: Epsilon Indi B
identity.product_scope: official SPHEREx validation target outside the heliocentric 1000 au science scene; separate detail viewer only

adopted_primary_reference.title: Precise Dynamical Masses of Epsilon Indi Ba and Bb: Evidence of Slowed Cooling at the L/T Transition
adopted_primary_reference.rights: Raw paper retained as local research audit; factual extraction and direct citation do not grant blanket redistribution rights for the PDF/figures.

dynamical_measurements.uncertainty: posterior mean and one standard deviation per Table 4

Gaia_EDR3_A_distance_pc_quoted_in_paper.body: Epsilon Indi A; not a direct independent Ba/Bb distance

relative_orbit.limitation: T0 was fitted but no numerical T0 is present in the reviewed Table 4. Do not invent orbital phase or assign representative body locations to the current SPHEREx epoch. Sky-plane orbit and line-of-sight branch/conventions require explicit validation before a time-accurate 3D orbit.

claims_not_supported: measured cloud belts on the surface
true natural colour of a resolved globe
a newly imaged surface from SPHEREx

radius_reference.model: COND03 at adopted system age 3.7-4.3 Gyr, original luminosities and preliminary total mass
radius_reference.warning: Do not combine these older COND03 radii with Chen-2022 SM08 temperatures as a single internally fitted physical solution. A viewer can expose this distinct literature range or leave physical radius null; its display radius must be marked illustrative.

historical_binary_discovery.title: Epsilon Indi Ba/Bb: the nearest binary brown dwarf

resolved_image.colour: published intensity-colour rendering; not natural RGB colour
resolved_image.rights_source: Unmodified original JPEG embedded XMP xmpRights:UsageTerms and photoshop:Credit; extracted XMP saved alongside raw JPEG
resolved_image.page_access_status: Canonical web page returned JS challenge/403 via web tool; official image storage retrieval successful with default TLS validation
resolved_image.provider_scope_note: Additional direct primary observatory image beyond requested ESO/NASA/paper providers; no third-party image copy was used.

eso_context_image.kind: SSS I-band and 2MASS Ks sky collage; does not resolve Ba/Bb surfaces or binary detail

conflicting_old_mass_reference.status: disagrees with adopted Chen-2022 study; do not merge or silently average

implementation_proposal.entry: Existing epsilon-indi-b target selection opens an explicit separate binary detail view; retain official actual-observation CTA and same target ID.
implementation_proposal.default_content: Real Gemini snapshot with fixed 2003 acquisition label plus Ba/Bb physical facts and source links.
implementation_proposal.three_d_content: Optional two-globe atmosphere illustration and literature relative-orbit shape; representative arrangement/view scale explicitly labelled. No observed surface texture or date-accurate orbital phase claim.
implementation_proposal.distance_scope: Do not add a fabricated Ba/Bb physical position inside 1000 au or turn a sky-direction ring into a fake heliocentric orbit.
implementation_proposal.state_separation: Separate detail camera from solar scene/observation epoch. Going back preserves time, selected observation IDs, source hashes, quality policy and evidence context.
implementation_proposal.phase_accurate_orbit_followup: Acquire verified machine-readable T0/covariance and coordinate/node conventions; independently compare positions to published relative astrometry before any current-date animation.

validation_limits: No app/Scene/API/source-manifest edits or current-release integration performed.
Raw paper/image bytes and acquisition SHA preserved; no generated appearance asset replaces observation data.
A surface-unresolved brown dwarf must not be presented as a resolved photographic globe.
The current SPHEREx EPSF/pixel sampling cannot be treated as a resolved Ba/Bb surface image.
No galaxy/exoplanet catalogue, arbitrary interstellar scene or additional population is reintroduced.
